runtime_input_policy.copyright_rule: Rebuild a new scene from the light, space and crop grammar. Never trace the exact table texture, shadow masses, waffle details or magazine alignment.

allowed_style_features: one large close product assembly on a warm ivory-white matte table
broad upper-left diffuse window light and soft lower-right shadows
narrow off-frame sliver of a normal-size waffle plate at upper-left
small off-frame corner of a normal-size Barton Springs magazine at upper-right
quiet off-frame occupancy shadows and finite depth falloff
low straight cylindrical reference glass in adopt-reference mode, with the approved saucer and wood-handled teaspoon completing the serving assembly in both modes

asymmetry_sources: narrow off-frame waffle sliver at upper-left and small off-frame magazine corner at upper-right
micro_moments: the drink has just been set on the table
room air and window shadows continue outside the crop

tone_contract.background_plane: warm ivory-white matte tabletop inside a real white cafe room
tone_contract.color_bias: warm-neutral white with neutral gray shadows, never beige or blue
tone_contract.highlight_behavior: soft protected shoulder retaining table, glass, cream and paper texture

main_subject.role: one large exact user beverage and serving assembly

secondary_subjects.role: narrow off-frame sliver of a normal-size waffle plate at upper-left frame edge
small off-frame corner of a normal-size Barton Springs magazine at upper-right frame edge

composition.camera_angle: natural high three-quarter view at 42-49 degrees
composition.horizon_visibility: none; room depth is implied by light, overlap, edge crops and finite focus falloff
composition.depth_of_field: complete product and spoon readable; edge props mildly and physically defocused
composition.alignment: large central product balanced by peripheral edge crops

lighting.type: one very large diffuse window source plus weak neutral white-room bounce
lighting.intensity: protected natural daylight at -0.15 to 0 EV
lighting.shadow: compact attached contacts plus broad low-density lower-right penumbrae and faint off-frame occupancy modulation
lighting.highlight_control: retain white table, saucer, cream, glass rim, spoon and magazine paper texture without clipping

color.saturation: low globally; preserve beverage-internal color relationships while re-illuminating bright low-chroma milk or cream into the target warm-neutral exposure

scene.surface: warm ivory-white matte cafe tabletop with subtle real texture
scene.background: minimal white interior implied by diffuse light and off-frame spatial shadows
props: narrow off-frame waffle sliver at upper-left edge
small off-frame magazine corner at upper-right edge
scene.texture: subtle matte table variation, paper fiber, natural food texture and finite social-photo grain

capture.look: natural high three-quarter Instagram cafe close-up with quiet white-room depth
capture.realism: one physical exposure and one broad window source connect product, continuous tabletop and distant edge props
capture.grain: faint luminance grain after ordinary social compression
imperfections: natural beverage, ice and garnish asymmetry

hard_lock: exact user beverage identity, layers, ice and toppings
one large central cup-saucer-spoon serving assembly
low straight cylindrical reference glass, complete warm-white saucer and wood-handled teaspoon together in adopt-reference mode
exact user cup centered on the approved saucer with the approved teaspoon in preserve-source mode
narrow off-frame waffle sliver left and small off-frame magazine corner right
editable: minor edge-prop crop and focus falloff

prompt_blocks.input_roles: Image 1 owns beverage identity and the user cup when selected. Image 2 owns the approved white-closeup composition, diffuse light, saucer, wood-handled teaspoon and peripheral depth cues.
prompt_blocks.composition: One large cup-saucer-spoon serving assembly fills the central-lower 4:5 frame at 110% of the prior white-closeup guide, while the entire saucer and spoon remain visible; only a narrow off-frame sliver of a normal-size waffle plate enters upper-left and a small off-frame corner of a normal-size Barton Springs magazine enters upper-right; preserve the approved perspective and scale hierarchy.
prompt_blocks.look: Warm-neutral white interior, one broad upper-left/left-front diffuse window at 5050-5250K, soft lower-right contacts, long feathered penumbrae, restrained transmission through glass and liquid, and faint off-frame occupancy shadows with real room air.
prompt_blocks.preservation: Preserve beverage identity and internal color relationships, not its original absolute white point. In adopt mode use the approved low straight cylindrical reference glass, complete saucer and wood-handled teaspoon; in preserve mode keep the exact user cup on that same approved saucer with that teaspoon.
prompt_blocks.negative: No overhead view, round-table edge, table leg, tiled floor, grout, flat white void, studio sweep, miniature waffle, centered magazine, hard sunlight, beige veil, missing saucer, missing or malformed spoon, floating product, CGI liquid, HDR halo or watermark.

quality_gates.logo_text: do not tilt the overhead camera to reveal source sidewall branding; omit branding when it is not naturally visible, and keep the adopted reference mug plain unless a separate target brand contract authorizes otherwise
quality_gates.product_identity: beverage and selected cup remain authoritative
quality_gates.preset_adherence: large close cup-saucer-spoon assembly, two peripheral edge props, white-room air and one diffuse light all pass
quality_gates.artifact_policy: reject flat white, missing or malformed serving components, miniature props, hard shadows, clipped whites, pasted edges or copied scene pixels

failure_recovery: restore exact beverage and selected cup
restore the complete saucer and wood-handled teaspoon
restore one broad diffuse source and spatial shadows
